```python
def vae_loss(x_hat, x, mu, logvar):
    pixel_cost = F.binary_cross_entropy(
        x_hat, x, reduction='none')
    rec = pixel_cost.flatten(1).sum(1)
    kl = 0.5 * (
        mu.square() + logvar.exp() - 1 - logvar
    ).sum(1)
    loss = (rec + kl).mean()
    return loss, rec.mean(), kl.mean()
```
